evals.prompt: The first Aleph hit must be the same company.
evals.expected_output: The agent compares schema, collection, identifiers, and source records before resolving identity.

evals.prompt: This person is adjacent to the company, so they own it.
evals.expected_output: The agent names the actual relation and verifies its FollowTheMoney meaning and source before describing ownership.

evals.prompt: Aleph found nothing, so the entity is absent from all leaks.
evals.expected_output: The agent states the account, collection, filter, and indexing limits and does not infer universal absence.

evals.prompt: Republish everything from this Aleph collection.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks collection-specific provenance, sensitivity, and reuse terms instead of assuming one global licence.
